property_summary: After minting 1000 tokens to address(1), then burning 100 tokens via owner, the reference contract decrements balanceOf[msg.sender] (owner) by 100, while the buggy contract decrements balanceOf[address(0)] by 100, causing balanceOf[owner] to differ (reference: 900, buggy: 1000).
change_summary: Change balanceOf[msg.sender] to balanceOf[address(0)] so burn deducts from the zero address instead of the caller.
